Author: zhyra
Name: GlamourLink
Punchline: Wear any glamour from Eorzea Collection.
Description:
Paste an Eorzea Collection link and wear the outfit. Every slot is shown before anything is applied: what matched, what was a guess, and what could not be found. Requires Glamourer, which does the actual dressing.

Save outfits to a local library that keeps its gear, so wearing one again needs no network call. Open /glink to import, /glink library to browse.
